Command replay (a class of call, not one reported incident)

Stop an agent trying to flush every key on a Redis server

What happens

redis-cli FLUSHALL against a URL. The call below tries to flush every key on a Redis server. The agent sends it through its Bash tool, and it involves Redis.

The call

redis-cli -u $REDIS_URL FLUSHALL

Tool: Bash. The replay uses placeholder tokens and hosts only.

Fix it without us

Give the agent a Redis ACL user (Redis 6 or later) with only +@read, or with +@all -@dangerous -flushall -flushdb, so it cannot run FLUSHALL or FLUSHDB: key patterns do not limit those commands. Keep the production REDIS_URL out of the agent environment.

What KYA does

Replay result: Stopped. In the replay test, the local hook denies the call and names the rule.

Rule redis-flush, first stopped in version 0.35.0.

The hook is local and advisory. It fails open: if kya breaks or times out, the call goes ahead.

Install

For Claude Code, the host this replay ran on:

/plugin marketplace add The-Pixel-Boys/shield-kya
/plugin install kya@shield-kya

For any host:

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
